turn1_prompt:
Record 1
Determine whether this underwater sound is a deliberately transmitted signal or source-radiated noise.
Options:
A. Active - Deliberately transmitted signal
B. Passive - Source-radiated noise
Select exactly one option. Reply with the uppercase option letter only, without explanation or any additional text.
turn2_prompt:
Good — the signal is actively transmitted. Now determine whether it is a detection pulse or communication signal, and specify the exact type.
Options:
A. Active — Detection pulse — CW (Continuous Wave)
B. Active — Detection pulse — LFM (Linear Frequency Modulation)
C. Active — Detection pulse — HFM (Hyperbolic Frequency Modulation)
D. Active — Communication — 2FSK (Binary Frequency Shift Keying)
E. Active — Communication — 4FSK (Quaternary Frequency Shift Keying)
F. Active — Communication — BPSK (Binary Phase Shift Keying)
G. Active — Communication — QPSK (Quadrature Phase Shift Keying)
H. Active — Communication — OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing)
Select exactly one option. Reply with the uppercase option letter only, without explanation or any additional text.
turn3_output: This is a source-radiated signal, specifically a Underwater vehicle (Ship-radiated noise). Based on time-frequency analysis, the signal exhibits characteristic Underwater vehicle acoustic features.
